records.text: The viewer introduced as 78 Lead Head asserted that autistic children can be pressured to confess to anything and described a personal instance in which his son accepted blame for something his brother had done; the commenter’s identity is unverified.
records.speaker: 78 Lead Head (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: 78 Lead Head (commenter handle; identity unverified) writes, 'As the father of a young man who is autistic, my heart breaks for Brian Cole Jr.' ... and his family. It also enrages me to no end. Anyone with an autistic child knows that you can get them to confess to anything if you put pressure on them. ... I have accidentally accused my son of things that his brother did and he accepted guilt only for me to find out the truth later and I've asked him, son, why did you admit something that you didn't do? ... And he said, I don't. I don't know. God bless their hearts. They are very innocent souls. Yeah.
